list.title: Projects
list.emptyDescription: Create a project to connect a repository and set up environments.
list.noAccess: You haven't been given access to any projects yet. Ask an Admin to add you.

create.title: Create a project
create.name: Project name
create.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Used in links; can't be changed later.

settings.title: Project settings
settings.readOnly: Only project Admins can change these settings.
settings.deleteDescription: Permanently removes {{project}}, its environments and its repository connection. OpsHub's webhook is removed from the Git host.

environments.title: Environments
environments.description: Where this project deploys. Pipelines refer to environments by name.
environments.emptyDescription: Most projects start with development, staging and production.
environments.name: Name
environments.nameHint: Lowercase, like production or staging-eu. Can't be changed later.
environments.variablesHint: Non-secret settings passed to deployments. Don't put passwords or keys here — secrets get their own safe storage.
environments.protectHint: Deployments need approval and are limited to certain branches and roles.
environments.approvalsHint: 0 means no approval is needed. Whoever starts a deployment can't approve it.
environments.branchesHint: One per line. Use * as a wildcard, e.g. release/*. Leave empty to allow any branch.
environments.deleteBody: Pipelines that deploy to {{name}} will fail until you create it again.

repository.title: Repository
repository.description: Connect the GitHub or GitLab repository this project builds from.
repository.notConnectedReadOnly: A project Admin can connect a repository.
repository.baseUrlHint: For GitHub Enterprise or a self-managed GitLab, e.g. https://git.example.com. Leave empty for github.com or gitlab.com.
repository.tokenHintGithub: A fine-grained token with read access to contents and read/write access to webhooks. Stored encrypted; never shown again.
repository.tokenHintGitlab: A project or personal access token with the api scope (Maintainer role to create webhooks). Stored encrypted; never shown again.
repository.disconnectBody: OpsHub deletes the stored token and removes its webhook from the Git host.
repository.manualIntro: OpsHub couldn't add the webhook itself. Add it in your repository's webhook settings with these values:

manualReasons.token_cannot_manage_webhooks: The token doesn't have permission to manage webhooks.
manualReasons.provider_rejected_webhook: The Git host rejected the webhook (for example, it can't reach this OpsHub address).
manualReasons.provider_unreachable: The Git host couldn't be reached.

repository.secretOnce: This secret is shown only once. If you lose it, connect the repository again to get a new one.
repository.deliveriesEmpty: No deliveries yet. Push a commit to try it.

access.title: Access
access.description: Who can work on this project. The organization's Owners and Admins always have access; its Viewers can view every project.
access.removeBody: They keep any access that comes from their organization role or another team.
access.nobody: Everyone in the organization already has access.

roleDescriptions.admin: Manages settings, access, the repository and environments.
roleDescriptions.developer: Runs pipelines and deploys to environments that allow Developers.
